name: Egg Roll
body:
Station and Complexity friturier 3

Flavor Profiles umami, texture
Additional Ingredients bitter, salty, sour, spicy, or sweet

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level; Serving Size 1
Saving Throw Reflex vs. splash damage

DESCRIPTION

An egg roll is a fried wrapper (eggs, flour, water), rolled and cut into squares, then filled with meats and vegetaples. If is often served with dipping sauce.

When completed, an egg roll can be consumed or thrown immediately as your attack. If consumed, it heals you for an amount of damage equal to 2d6 + your Intelligence or Wisdom modifier. If thrown, it acts as an alchemist’s bomb that deals fire damage equal to 2d6 + your Intelligence or Wisdom modifier. You are proficient with your egg rolls.

Additional ingredients increase the duration and serving size by +1 each and the damage healed or dealt by 1d6 each. This also allows you to distribute the egg rolls to allies to be consumed within the duration. Allies can only consume up to 1 serving per meal.

Additional salty ingredients allow you to change the damage dealt to electricity.

Additional sour ingredients allow you to change the damage dealt to acid.

Additional spicy ingredients allow you to change the damage dealt to fire.
